theorems.name: Submission.dsmc_chart_range_subset_tangentSpace
theorems.statement: ∀ (P r d : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P), 1 ≤ r → IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ r ψ V → ψ '' V ⊆ N → ∀ v ∈ V, Set.range (fderiv ℝ ψ v) ⊆ tangentSpace N (ψ v)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
